mismatch.source: Wrong worn-glove state owner suppresses wash_hands; next RNG mismatch at step88 is consequent ER_GREASED gate omission.

summary: The selected object is the hero’s worn slippery gloves. Upstream fountain.c:dipfountain compares it with the canonical uarmg pointer and calls wash_hands(), which clears Glib and returns ER_GREASED when the wash itself does not damage the gloves. js/fountain.js tests obj === state.u.uarmg, but this port stores the canonical equipment pointer at state.uarmg. It therefore skips wash_hands and runs the ordinary fountain effect. A fresh replay of the unchanged admitted C recording at the examined accepted commit 79a81f748863d6c0e694c4c22729021f2a2d6e7a independently reproduces the first screen/cursor mismatch at segment 0, step 87, key y; the next RNG mismatch at step 88 is C rn2(2)=1 versus JS rnd(30)=8.

source.branch: After levitation and Excalibur checks, if the selected object is hands_obj or exactly the hero’s worn-gloves object uarmg, dipfountain calls wash_hands. wash_hands records prior Glib, clears it, water-damages canonical uarmg if present, and returns ER_GREASED if Glib was cleared without glove damage. dipfountain then applies the ER_DESTROYED / ER_NOTHING / rn2(2) early-return condition before the ordinary rnd(30) fate.
callers: potion.c:dodip (2267-2415): after getobj selection and fountain confirmation, calls dipfountain(obj) and returns ECMD_TIME.
js/potion.js:dodip (3293-3330): passes the selected object to dipfountain(obj, state, env) after fountain confirmation.

evidence: Pinned upstream source nethack-c/upstream/src/fountain.c at gitlink 16ff59115315917b93185d026aeefea06db9b0f4: dipfountain lines 394-554 contains `else if (is_hands || obj == uarmg) er = wash_hands();`; the subsequent early return checks ER_DESTROYED or (er != ER_NOTHING && !rn2(2)) before switch (rnd(30)).

Pinned upstream fountain.c lines 558-577: wash_hands captures `was_glib`, calls make_glib(0), calls water_damage(uarmg, ...) when worn gloves exist, and converts ER_NOTHING to ER_GREASED when prior Glib was set.
Production entry is wired in fountain.c caller potion.c:dodip (2267-2415); the JavaScript production counterpart is js/potion.js:dodip and passes the selected equipment object to dipfountain.

In accepted source js/fountain.js at examined commit 79a81f748863d6c0e694c4c22729021f2a2d6e7a, dipfountain’s selector compares `obj === state.u.uarmg`; the already-used wash_hands implementation reads and mutates `state.uarmg` (lines 1137-1165), establishing the wrong pointer owner in the dispatch predicate.
